platform: 8 B200 GPUs, full index replication, 64 worker lanes, 10M rows x 128 dimensions, k=500
notes: Initial EWMA routing failed to age slow estimates; two replicas received no requests in the 10pct scan measurement.
The aged implementation includes idle estimate decay and recovery probes. The aged sweep measures 10pct only, 15 seconds per point after 10 seconds warm-up.
Scans use 256 clients; batches of 16 use 64 clients. Compare policies within each client/batch setting.
Home remains the default. Adaptive routing did not produce a throughput gain in uniform or single-GPU GEMM contention tests.
Contention: an independent CuPy FP16 4096x4096 GEMM loop runs on GPU 0 for 55 seconds; 10pct, k=500, 15 seconds per contention point, same process/client settings as the aged sweep.
Recovery uses a 10-second scan after the contention process exits; waiting for that process leaves a short idle interval.
